evidence: Modifies `src/wallet/test/coinselection_tests.cpp` to correctly test wallet SRD coin selection eviction behavior.
rationale: Ensures coin selection tie-breaking logic is actually exercised by the unit test suite. The existing test passed `utxo_pool` instead of `mixed_weight_pool` and set a weight limit too high to trigger evictions, allowing regressions of #33223 to pass undetected.
